title: Unwind at Turks & Caicos | Rosemary Beach Cottage | Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: An unforgettable vacation awaits when you book this amazing Rosemary Beach cottage with a beautiful private courtyard, sun room style kitchen and many amenities! Book now!
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Situated fronting the tennis courts on one of the main boardwalks that leads to one of Rosemary Beach's four pools, Eastern Green and beach, location is ideal. A beautiful private brick courtyard and lawn with ample space for both the main and carriage houses to enjoy, not often found in Rosemary Beach. A wonderful built in seating area with fire pit is located at one end of lawn. Entering the the main house from the courtyard you find a sun room style kitchen and dining room, enhanced by charming ten foot heart pine doors that let outdoor beauty shine in. A brick wall, concrete floors, granite counter tops, high-end stainless appliances, all combine to complete the charming yet modern feel to the room. The open flow from the dining area leads to the living room, flooded with natural light. There is a natural gas fireplace with a recessed television space to keep things streamlined and uncluttered. Tucked behind this is an office nook and room for all things electronic. At the opposite end of the living room is a first floor bedroom and renovated bathroom.

Upstairs on the second floor is located a guest bedroom with king and renovated bathroom, including a tiled shower/tub. Also on the second floor is a true master suite that opens to a large balcony. The master bath is all new with large walk-in shower, dual shower heads, built in bench seat, standing glass panel. A walk-in closet completes the bath suite.

Ascending the spiral staircase to the third floor you find a haven for kids. There are four twin beds in the center area, a large bathroom with brightly colored glass tiles and a huge shower at one end.

DURING SUMMER THIS PROPERTY RENTS 7 NIGHTS FROM SATURDAY TO SATURDAY
